extracted_items.text: ## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Search Routing and Deep-Link Payload Normalization
Targeted docs: FinalGUISpec, Orchestrator_Page, UI_Command_Catalog, usage-feature, Runtime_Artifacts_Panel, assistant-chat-design, chain-wizard-flexibility

Docs already contain many navigation mechanisms: command palette, resume_url deep links, Show in Ledger/Usage, Orchestrator pivots (Source Control, GitHub Actions, Docker Manager), chat/thread navigation, open-file contract, local tab search/filter

UI_Command_Catalog.md exposes route-like commands: cmd.artifacts.open_panel, cmd.orchestrator.open_in_source_control, cmd.orchestrator.open_in_github_actions, cmd.orchestrator.open_in_docker_manager, graph focus/filter, chat usage focus/open
Still missing: one shared destination payload model spanning search results, command palette, widget drill-downs, deep links, resume URLs, cross-surface Show in pivots
Define one shared routing payload contract rather than separate ad hoc payloads per surface; object model is too broad for accidental consistency
Shared routing contract should apply across Orchestrator, Source Control, Usage/Ledger, Artifacts, chat/Interview/Builder recovery links

Candidate shared routing fields: project_id, actor_run_kind?, focused_run_id?, thread_id?, wizard_id?, destination_surface, destination_tab?, object_kind?, object_id?, record_id?, artifact_id?, attempt_id?, lane_id?, worktree_id?, usage_event_ref?, filter_payload?, inspector_target?, scroll_target?, focus_behavior? — composable, not all required per route

Candidate object_kind vocabulary: run, feature_seam, work_package, node, lane, worktree, concern, promotion, review, corroboration, graph_patch, recovery_record, blocked_episode, usage_record, artifact, thread, wizard, bundle
resume_url stays human-meaningful for recovery; decoded payload must normalize into same routing contract as in-app search and command routing

Search result activation must reconstruct context (scope before target): e.g. focused_run_id, correct tab, filter payload, inspector on target; same for Show in Ledger/Usage, Resume Wizard, thread deep links
Open in / Show in actions should be thin wrappers over shared routing payload; preserve canonical usage identity and run/thread/attempt/worktree linkage
Persistence-aware routing: some activations update stored view state (e.g. search to historical run updates focused_run_id); hover/compare pivots may stay transient
Degraded projection trust: route to canonical fallback representation when possible (e.g. concern deep link to Ledger-backed inspector vs rollup tab)
Route mechanisms are per-feature; risks inconsistent activation, duplicate context reconstruction, palette/search/widget/deep-link mismatches; resume_url more specific than some Orchestrator pivots
Define shared routing/deep-link payload; stable object_kind/object_id; restore scope not just surface; normalize Open/Show commands as adapters
Do-not-forget: payloads restore focused_run_id etc.; URL and in-app decode to same model; degraded surfaces routable to canonical fallbacks
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Historical Semantic Consistency Across Record Families

Strong historical/lineage rules already: blocked projections stay historical after resolution; stale_historical attempts never resumable; safe-point restore mints new attempt; worktree refs survive prune; archived vs deleted threads distinct
Consistency goal: separate cross-family semantic words from family-local lifecycle vocabularies (not one universal enum)
Cross-family historical core terms: historical, stale_historical, superseded, revoked, reopened, archived, removed
historical: queryable past state no longer active focus

stale_historical: not resumable for live execution; superseded: replaced by canonical successor; revoked: withdrawn promoted/active state; reopened: closed path back to active; archived: retained off default UI; removed: live backing gone, identity may persist
Do not force family-local workflows into cross-family core; keep annotation, concern, wizard status lifecycles family-specific with cross-family overlays where relevant

Contracts_V0.md remediation.resolved conflict: one section enum fixed/superseded/abandoned/replan_required vs another success/failed/ceiling_exceeded — semantic conflict at remediation lineage intersection
Remediation should use one canonical resolution family; richer lineage-aware enum preferred over coarse success/failed
resolved does not always mean problem disappeared; needs family-local payload (blocked historical, concern accepted_risk/superseded, annotation workflow completion)
Preserve distinct meanings: archived vs removed vs deleted; removed live backing ≠ erased canonical history
reopened/revoked/superseded reserved for true lineage-changing transitions (promotions, seam truth, graph generations, recovery)
Search/ledger must distinguish current vs historical, superseded vs revoked, archived vs removed, stale_historical vs historical
Shared overlay vocabulary; family-local states stay distinct; reconcile remediation.resolved; ledger/search preserve distinctions
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Concern Record Structure and Interaction Rules
No canonical concern record family in docs comparable to attempts/blocked/usage/evidence/wizard; concerns need identity, lineage, sources, interaction rules — not just badges
Keep concern distinct from review finding, annotation, blocked episode, graph patch request, recovery record; cross-link but separate families

Recommended concern fields: concern_id, project_id, run_id?, scope_type, scope_id, status, severity, category, summary, description?, owner_kind?, origin_kind, timestamps, resolution_kind?, rationale, ack/dismiss actors+times, source_refs, evidence_refs, related_record_refs, lineage_refs, blocked_episode_refs?, promotion_refs?, graph_patch_refs?, recovery_refs?
Concern lifecycle: active/acknowledged/resolved/dismissed — ack/dismiss are governance; resolved must carry exact resolution semantics

resolved must not be bare; resolution_kind candidates: fixed, accepted_risk, superseded, merged, split, invalidated, obsoleted_by_patch, obsoleted_by_recovery; dismissed ≠ resolved; accepted_risk is resolution not dismissal
Merge: collapse concerns with lineage refs; split: original resolves resolution_kind split; superseded: replaced by newer concern; old ids stay queryable
Repeated sightings should update existing concern vs duplicates; no auto-merge on similar summary — use scope/category/lineage heuristics or governance

Interactions: reviews nominate concerns; corroboration validates/downgrades/minority; graph patch resolves/obsoletes/splits; recovery resolves or spawns follow-on; blocked episodes reference concerns but are not replaced by them
UI mapping: Progress summaries, Seams rollups, Evidence linkage, History timeline, Ledger exact record/lineage/ack-dismiss rationale; search: active/ack/dismissed + lineage by prior id
Notifications: acknowledged reduces noise; active+execution impact escalates; dismissed suppresses concern UI but not active blocked episodes; blocked_owner ≠ concern owner
No concern event/record family in local SSOT; semantics distributed in ledger; absence riskier given adjacent durable-record rigor
Canonical concern record + projection; explicit merge/split/supersession lineage; resolution_kind + rationale on resolve/dismiss paths; keep separation from adjacent families
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Gemini broader second-sweep delta cluster (identity, storage, UI ownership)

Requested identity under-modeled downstream; tier_id/run.tier_* still central in storage-plan and usage-feature vs seam_id/package_id/lane_id; graph-patch lineage and degraded projection trust under-specified
Orchestrator_Page centers Tiers; Widget_System widgetizes surfaces trending native; Run_Graph_View lacks concern/corroboration/promotion/patch lineage
GitHub_Integration worktree ownership run/tier-framed; FileManager open contract path-first; Runtime_Artifacts_Panel missing attempt_id in canonical id set; weak degraded-artifact semantics
Impacted docs: storage-plan, usage-feature, Contracts_V0, GitHub_API_Auth_and_Flows, GitHub_Integration, Run_Graph_View, Orchestrator_Page, Widget_System, FileManager, Runtime_Artifacts_Panel

Shared requested/effective identity disclosure; first-class seam_id, package_id, lane_id, attempt_id attribution; deprecate tier-era events/widgets; artifact routing on stable ids; explicit projection freshness/degraded trust in UI docs

Do-not-forget: effective_provider_identity is display not routing key; source-qualified usage for estimate-only providers; dashboard widgets ≠ widgetize all tabs; attempt_id cross-surface anchor; cluster is early delta
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Gemini broader second-sweep delta cluster (policy, invariants, authority drift)

Governance lag: Decision_Policy lacks concern/corroboration/promotion authority rules; Permissions_System lags requested/effective model; Architecture_Invariants needs lane ordering and mutation-safe-point rules

Authority framed monolithically vs seam/package overseer scopes, blocked-owner, runtime/system/user split; worktree rules not globally uniform (chain-wizard intent modes, ContributePr single-branch); policy still tier-context while invariants are node_id/attempt_id/blocked_reason_code-first
Impacted: Decision_Policy, Permissions_System, Architecture_Invariants, chain-wizard-flexibility, orchestrator-subagent-integration, Executor_Protocol, human-in-the-loop

HITL/blocked still tier_id/tier_type in places vs node_id/attempt anchors; Decision_Policy silent on who acknowledges concerns, revokes promotions, confirms corroboration, owns blocked under overseer model; contract unification conflict resolution underdefined

Extend Decision_Policy for concerns/corroboration/promotions and superseded/revoked/reopened; identity fields in decision/permission records; invariants for runtime object families, lane scheduler integrity, safe points; intent-specific worktree modes + contract-unification conflicts
Do-not-forget: blocked_reason_code SSOT; attempt_id unique per dispatch; ack concerns reduce noise not true blockers; recovery snapshots need intent/wizard-step to avoid wrong execution mode
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Opus broader second-sweep delta cluster (canonical contract drift and native-surface ownership)

requested_persona_id/effective_persona_id drift vs Contracts_V0 prohibition; provider_account_id shadow-identity risk; usage/storage lack shared governance-record envelope; widget/native contradiction for non-Progress tabs
Normalize to canonical requested_*/effective_* names; shared identity disclosure pattern; governance-record template; seam/package/attempt attribution; only Progress widget-composed
Do-not-forget: relate provider_account_id to effective_account_id/effective_provider_identity; historical-run for widgets/graph; GitHub realm isolation (github_api vs copilot_github)
## Research Progress - 2026-03-16 - Sonnet broader second-sweep delta cluster (requested-account asymmetry and event-schema precision)

requested_account_policy without canonical requested_account_id; event tables under-spec vs prose for run.started, usage.event, hitl.*; GitHub login as stable key vs account_id; addendum drift on safe_point.created, scheduler.pass, remediation.resolved
Widget_System lacks trust chrome; Dashboard push widgets lack no-active-run/historical contract; Orchestrator_Page tier-era tables; Run Graph missing governance fields/commands/trust

Add requested-side concrete account anchor; reconcile event rows with prose MUSTs; stable internal account ids not login; trust/idle/historical contracts in widget specs; tighten graph/page schemas on node_id, attempt_id, lane_id, seam_id, package_id + governance hooks
Do-not-forget: constrain generic page/tier command payloads; keep GitHub realm split; make addendum supersession explicit; Sonnet confirms hotspot doc focus for GPT passes
